title: Capturing In-Context Learning Dynamics with Task Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.01054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to perform new tasks from demonstrations without weight updates. However, every ICL inference requires processing the full set of examples, resulting in inefficient deployments, and how ICL works mechanistically is not fully understood. Prior work compresses ICL into fixed activation vectors extracted from specific layers or positions, but these input-independent interventions fail on complex tasks where the output depends on fine-grained interactions with the input. By analyzing the ICL forward pass, we show that each attention head's output is an affine transformation of its context-masked counterpart, and that the parameters of this transformation are empirically stable across samples for a given task. translated_title: 用任务算子捕捉上下文学习动态
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）使语言模型能够仅凭示例演示执行新任务，而无需更新权重。然而，每次ICL推理都需要处理完整的示例集合，导致部署效率低下，且ICL的作用机制尚未被完全理解。先前的工作将ICL压缩为从特定层或位置提取的固定激活向量，但这些与输入无关的干预方法在复杂任务上会失效，因为这类任务的输出取决于与输入之间的细粒度交互。通过分析ICL的前向传递过程，我们发现每个注意力头的输出是其上下文掩码对应输出的仿射变换，且该变换的参数在给定任务的不同样本间具有经验上的稳定性。基于这一发现，我们提出了任务算子（Task Operator, TO），它将这一变换作为解析推导出的更新重放到注意力输出投影中。在词汇类、算法类……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出任务算子（TO）方法，通过将注意力头输出的仿射变换解析地重放到注意力输出投影中，从而无需处理完整示例即可高效模拟上下文学习，并揭示其内在机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Task Operator (TO), an analytically derived update to attention output projections that captures in-context learning dynamics, enabling efficient ICL without processing the full set of demonstrations.
